title: Shell variables
summary: Store a value, use it with $, and pass it on to the programs you start.

text: - name=value stores a value. No spaces around the =: name = sam is a command called name.
$( ) runs a command and puts what it prints in its place.
- Handy to keep a date, a count, a file name for later.
A plain variable stays in your shell. export hands it to the programs you start: an environment variable.
